title: Special Call: Fellowships in the ZiF-Group "Practices of Interdisciplinary Research"
institution: Center for Interdisciplinary Research (ZiF), Bielefeld University
about: Bielefeld University's ZiF offers 8 to 10 fellowships in its curated group 'Practices of Interdisciplinary Research', a six-month residency in Bielefeld, Germany from October 2028 to March 2029. Applicants need a doctorate and an institutional affiliation. Deadline: 9 February 2027.
requirements: Affiliation with a university or research institute
Confirmation of granted leave from the home institution

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: seniority "Researchers with a doctoral degree" → objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

field "Study of interdisciplinary research (all disciplines)" → objective "Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps."
